headline: Kalpataru Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - Kalpataru Limited has informed the Exchange about acquisition of equity shares of Agile Real Estate Private Limited and Agile Real Estate Dev Private Limited, step down Subsidiaries of the Company, by Kalpataru Properties…
detail: General Updates - Kalpataru Limited has informed the Exchange about acquisition of equity shares of Agile Real Estate Private Limited and Agile Real Estate Dev Private Limited, step down Subsidiaries of the Company, by Kalpataru Properties Limited ( KPL ), a Step down Wholly Owned Subsidiary of the Company
